# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Capability edited: **system-prompt only** (`prompt.md`). No tools.py in this edit space, so all fixes are prompt/policy knowledge edits for the sonnet-4-5 reader.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage = #tasks × trials × score recoverable)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Reading formula cells returns the formula TEXT, not the computed value** → agent skips them / treats as 0 / hardcodes → wrong sums & dates → 0 | 374-9 (all trials that skipped `=SUM(...)` cells scored 0; the one data_only trial rose to partial), 40467 (B/C are `=A1+1`/`=A1+5`, A2..A10 are `=A(n-1)+7`; t0 hardcoded base date 2023-12-31 → cases 2,3 failed) | openpyxl default `.value` on a formula cell is a `=`-string; `isinstance(v,(int,float))` skips it | KNOWLEDGE (openpyxl behavior the reader doesn't reliably know) | New subsection: read computed values via a second `data_only=True` handle; never treat a `=`-string as 0 |
| 2 | **Hardcoded base value / assumed fixed inter-row step** that only fits the sample file → other test files (different start/step) fail | 40467 (t0 hardcoded 2023-12-31 + `7*(row-1)`), general partial-credit risk | reader reconstructs per-row inputs by extrapolation instead of reading them | KNOWLEDGE/generalization | Added rule under "Make your code GENERAL": derive each output from that row's own source inputs; never hardcode an observed base or assume a fixed step |
| — | Empty instruction (nbsp) — no intent to infer | 55457 (0.00) | instruction is literally `\xa0` | unfixable by general prompt | SKIPPED |
| — | 12-month rolling-window / sign semantics from another tab | 32468 (0.00) | DISCOUNT source is plain numeric (no formulas); failure is window/sign semantics I cannot pin without ground truth | ambiguous | SKIPPED (data_only doesn't apply — source has no formulas) |
| — | Exact blank-row-deletion-above-"Gross Pay" semantics | 347-49 (0.00) | ambiguous which rows are deleted; no general rule recovers the exact set without overfitting | ambiguous | SKIPPED |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class (menu item) | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Add a missing rule + worked example (menu 4 + 5) | prompt.md | New "Reading cells that contain formulas" section: default `load_workbook` gives formula TEXT; open a second `data_only=True` read handle; never treat a `=`-string as blank/0; worked date example. General to any task that reads formula-valued source cells. | Yes — conditional ("when you need the computed result"); passing tasks read plain values. Recommends a SEPARATE read handle so the writable workbook/layout is untouched on save. |
| 2 | Add a narrowing generalization rule (menu 4) | prompt.md | Under "Make your code GENERAL": derive each output from that row/cell's own source inputs; never hardcode an observed base value or assume a fixed inter-row step. Directly kills 40467 t0's hardcoded 2023-12-31 + fixed +7. | Yes — 47484/53161 already compute dynamically; rule matches what passing trials do. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- Cluster 1: 40467 inspection (msg3/msg5, trial t0) shows `B1: value='=A1+1' type=str`, `A2: value='=A1+7' type=str`, while pandas (data_only) DataFrame shows the correct computed dates `2024-01-07`… → confirms default read yields formula text and data_only yields values. 374-9 trial t3 used `data_only=True` and rose from 0/3 (formula-skipping trials) to 1/3. Passing tasks 47484/52216/53161/160-6: winning code does NOT use data_only and reads plain values; 52216's only formulas (`=SUM(B10+B11)` row 12) sit OUTSIDE its C15:G16 answer range and the plain category table it reads → guidance does not change their behavior (blast radius: BOUNDED to tasks that read formula cells).
- Cluster 2: 40467 t0 code hardcodes `datetime(2023,12,31)+timedelta(7*(row-1))` → cases 2,3 (different start/step) scored 0; new rule tells it to read each row's real A value instead. Passing tasks already read from file dynamically → no behavior change.

## Blast-radius statement
Both edits are ADDITIVE KNOWLEDGE, conditional on "you need to read a formula cell's computed value" / "don't hardcode/extrapolate". No global decision/permission/refusal rule touched. Passing tasks in scope: 47484, 52216, 53161, 160-6 — none read formula-valued cells to compute their answer, so neither edit changes their trajectory. Class: BOUNDED.

## Process & features used
- Serial analysis (no subagents): 10 tasks × 5 trials read directly with python passes over `./trajectories/`; fan-out overhead not warranted for this size.
- Built on cand_0001 (ACCEPTED, val 0.540). Did NOT touch its accepted rules (no-formulas-write, general-code, type/format, preserve-outside). Nothing in LEDGER/JOURNAL was rejected, so nothing to avoid re-adding.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The new data_only read-handle guidance (second handle for reading, original for saving) — it is the single unifying fix for both 374-9 and 40467 and must not be reverted.
- The conditional (not blanket) framing of both new rules — keep them conditional so single-sheet/plain-value passing tasks stay untouched.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- 55457 (0.00): instruction is a non-breaking space (empty) — no intent to infer, unfixable by a general prompt without hardcoding.
- 32468 (0.00): DISCOUNT source is plain numeric (data_only inapplicable); failure is 12-month-window/sign semantics I cannot determine without ground truth — a guess here would risk the candidate.
- 347-49 (0.00): exact set of blank rows to delete above "Gross Pay" is ambiguous; no general rule recovers it without overfitting.
